# fromInternalFilesDir

android

fun [FileArtifactService.Companion](-file-artifact-service/-companion/index.html).[fromInternalFilesDir](from-internal-files-dir.html)(context: Context, subDir: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html) = FileArtifactService.DEFAULT_ARTIFACTS_SUBDIR): [FileArtifactService](-file-artifact-service/index.html)

Builds a [FileArtifactService](-file-artifact-service/index.html) rooted at `<internal files dir>/<subDir>` (Context.getFilesDir).

Internal storage is always available and app-private. Prefer [fromExternalFilesDir](from-external-files-dir.html) for artifacts (user content); use this when you specifically want internal storage.

Multiple agents in the same app can isolate their artifacts by passing a distinct [subDir](from-internal-files-dir.html). Uses Context.getApplicationContext internally to avoid leaking an `Activity`.
